name: skillmap
description: Local-first SkillOps CLI for scanning, doctoring, mapping, and routing agent skills across coding assistants.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Direct npm publish is disabled; use npm run release:candidate with an exact retained tarball and explicit approval.')"
scripts.build: node scripts/check-product-version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/normalize-build-modes.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && node scripts/generate-contracts.mjs --check && node --test test/phase1-contracts.mjs test/hosted-contracts.mjs test/hosted-seed-integrity.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node --test test/core.mjs test/slice-b-dashboard.mjs test/phase1-routing-readiness.mjs test/phase1-route-events.mjs test/phase2-backend-onboarding.mjs test/phase2-job-safety.mjs test/phase2-workspace-switch.mjs test/phase3-policy-sources.mjs
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build && node --test test/slice-b-share.mjs test/phase1-contracts.mjs test/phase1-route-events.mjs
scripts.test:migrations: npm run build && node --test test/slice-b-policy.mjs test/slice-b-identity.mjs test/phase1-workspace-state.mjs
scripts.test:failure: npm run build && node --test test/phase1-github-source-fetcher.mjs test/phase1-workspace-state.mjs test/phase1-skill-tree-limits.mjs test/phase1-route-events.mjs test/phase2-backend-onboarding.mjs test/phase2-filesystem-freshness.mjs test/phase2-job-safety.mjs test/phase2-workspace-switch.mjs
scripts.test:connector: npm run build && node --test test/phase2-local-connector.mjs test/phase2-workspace-switch.mjs
scripts.test:cross-browser: npm run test:browser:chromium && npm run test:browser:firefox && npm run test:browser:webkit
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run test:fixtures && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:integration && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:failure && npm run test:connector && npm run check:web && npm run test:browser-fixture && npm run test:cross-browser && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:visual && npm run test:perf && npm run test:consumer-install && npm run test:release-path

author: Masih Hedayati
